label: ⏳ Survival retention (KM lite)
description: Kaplan-Meier-style survival curve for user retention. Each user has a 'tenure' (days until churn or last seen) and a 'churned' flag. Output: survival probability per day.

eventColumn.label: Event (churned) column
eventColumn.help: 1 = churned (event observed), 0 = censored (still active at last observation).
